item.title: Consumer Groups, Offsets, and the __consumer_offsets Topic
item.description: What Is a Consumer Group? A consumer group is a set of consumer instances that jointly consume a topic. Kafka assigns each partition to exactly one consumer within the group at a time. item.title: Consumer Groups: Parallel Processing and Partition Assignment Strategies
item.description:
Consumer Group Fundamentals A consumer group is how Kafka distributes work across multiple consumers.
